csv_project_name: National Western Center Triangle On-Call Design Svc
csv_agency: City and County of Denver Public Works Dept
csv_scope_of_work: The Department of Transportation & Infrastructure ( DOTI ), City and County of Denver ( City ), has issued a Request for Qualifications (the RFQ ) for National Western Center Triangle Sitewide Design Services. The Triangle Sitewide Designer will support design activities for the Triangle primarily focused on the Triangle site plan refinement and the horizontal infrastructure to support the remaining campus development including, GES Connections: Marion Underpass (Vibrant Bond), but this firm will also provide design collaboration and coordination for planned future facilities, including the proposed new Arena, Parking Garage, Central Utility Plant, Community Ownership / Affordable Housing, and Renovations to the 1909 Arena.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Traffic Design Engineering

title: National Western Center Triangle On-Call Design Services
short_description: Sitewide design services for campus infrastructure and future facilities at Denver's National Western Center.
project_scope: Sitewide design services for the National Western Center Triangle in Denver, focused on refinement of the Triangle site plan and horizontal infrastructure supporting remaining campus development. The assignment also includes design collaboration and coordination for future facilities such as a proposed new arena, parking garage, central utility plant, community ownership/affordable housing, and renovations to the 1909 Arena. No quantitative technical characteristics such as spans, areas, or capacities are stated.
services: On-call/sitewide multidisciplinary design services including architecture, interior design/space planning, rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, structural engineering, and traffic design engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Includes structural engineering within a multidisciplinary design team.
- Involves an arena, parking garage, utility plant, and refurbishment of an existing arena, which may create opportunities for complex structural input.
- Early-stage sitewide and campus development role can be strategically relevant for future building and special-structure packages.
- However, the current procurement is broad general design services rather than a clearly defined structural or long-span assignment.
- Significant horizontal infrastructure and general planning content reduces direct fit compared with pure bridge or roof structure projects.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the source. The scope covers campus-wide horizontal infrastructure and coordination for multiple future facilities, including an arena, parking garage, utility plant, housing, and arena renovation, but no areas, capacities, or budgets are provided, so a realistic consolidated estimate is not possible from the available information.
fee_explanation: No fee, budget, or estimated design fee is stated in the source.
references_qualifications: RFQ for multidisciplinary sitewide design services. Requested disciplines include architecture, interior design/space planning, rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, structural engineering, and traffic design engineering. No specific minimum reference counts or qualification thresholds are stated in the source excerpt.
